_doc: Radiomaster Pocket running EdgeTX in USB Joystick (HID) mode, default AETR layout. Maps SDL/pygame axis indices to BF RC channels (1-8). pygame axis range is [-1, +1]; we map that to PWM µs [1000, 2000]. Adjust `invert` per axis if the radio reports stick-up as -1 (some EdgeTX configs do). `deadband` is the |axis| below which the channel is forced to 0 (i.e., centered = 1500 µs); 0.04 is conservative for the Pocket. AUX axes have no deadband — switches step discretely so any value is intentional. If your radio reports throttle as 0..+1 instead of -1..+1, set throttle.invert=true won't help — you'll need a custom mapping (or fix it on the radio side).
